overview: A desktop side-column summary with a title, optional main row and details, a required total, an optional notice and a required action.

default.title: Default
default.text: Always pass a title in normal use, such as “Payment summary”. Omitting it is an exception.

without-title.title: Without title
without-title.text: Omitting the title is an exception when the surrounding screen already identifies the summary.

notice.title: With notice
notice.text: The notice is optional and remains separate from the card.

details-only.title: Details only
details-only.text: Details can be supplied without a main item; the component renders every supplied detail.

api.intro: Transaction Summary is available on Web only and uses separate mainItem, details and total roles.
api.title: Optional title rendered above the card only when supplied. In normal use, always pass a title such as “Payment summary”; omitting it is an exception.
api.mainItem: Optional Transaction List Read Only item (`content` + `amount`) using Default density. It is never inferred from the first detail.
api.details: Optional Transaction List Read Only items (`content` + `amount`) using Compact density. Use at most four as a screen-level rule; the component renders all supplied details.
api.total: Required label/value row. A divider precedes it whenever a main item or details are present.
api.notice: Optional structured notice. Description is required; title is optional. A solid check-circle is recommended; `icon={null}` hides it.
api.action: Required action rendered full width outside the card.
api.className: Additional class name for the component root.

platforms.ios: Not available; use the mobile Transaction Footer at the bottom of the payment screen.
platforms.android: Not available; use the mobile Transaction Footer at the bottom of the payment screen.

rules: Use Summary in the side column of a desktop payment screen; Footer is the mobile component.

Each row is Transaction List Read Only: `content` accepts a title and description; `amount` accepts a value, default/positive/negative/inactive/strikethrough/strikethrough-neutral type, struck-through value, tag, and info. Use mainItem and details independently; the first detail is not promoted to main.
Use no more than four details as a screen-level rule. Summary renders every detail it receives.
The main item uses Default density and details use Compact. Rows have no internal divider; group dividers appear after main when details follow and before total whenever rows are above it.
The card is always light-up and overlaps the notice below it.
Keep the required action outside the card and notice.
